title: Ship-or-remove plugins/herdr-ticks: every hook calls a deleted tk herd command
description:
Found by the pwp final review (tick sx5, attempt 9). The epic deleted tk herd paint/notify/guard/collect/reconcile but left plugins/herdr-ticks/ unchanged, and every event hook it registers invokes one of them:

  guard-hook.sh:75          tk herd guard
  paint-hook.sh ~101        tk herd paint
  notify-hook.sh ~91        tk herd notify
  action-collect-tick.sh    tk herd collect
  action-retry-tick.sh      tk herd reconcile

README.md:21-27 still marks them 'Working' and herdr-plugin.toml registers the hooks. The hooks exit 0 by design, so every firing now fails SILENTLY, visible only in the plugin log. action-open-worktree.sh reads .tick/logs/herd manifests that no writer remains for. scripts/verify-herd-helper.sh and scripts/verify-herd-plugin.sh are orphaned end-to-end smokes of the deleted CLI.

Either remove the plugin and its smokes, or re-point them once ticfac equivalents exist. Do not leave hooks that fail silently.
notes:
2026-09-16 11:53 - DECISION FROM TICFAC (tick glb, run epic-9pd, 2026-09-16) — this is the answer si0 was waiting on.

ticfac now owns three of the five surfaces tk dropped:
- ticfac factory webhook (register / --status / --delete)
- ticfac herd paint
- ticfac herd notify
paint and notify read ticfac's exec-state attempt records and the run checkpoint — NOT tk spawn manifests, which no longer exist. So those hooks can be repointed.

Two are deliberately dropped, not moved:
- the orchestrator guard: its nudge semantics have no meaning for a program orchestrator. Liveness is 'ticfac status', attention is 'ticfac watch'.
- plugin install/check: the plugin is this repository's artifact, not ticfac's.

Consequence for this tick: the plugin's paint and notify hooks may be REPOINTED at the ticfac commands; its dashboard, collect and reconcile hooks call commands that no longer exist anywhere and must be RETIRED. Ship-or-remove is therefore 'ship, partly repointed, partly retired'.

The decision record on the ticfac side is 'ticfac herd --help' and the operator-surfaces table in its README.
acceptance_criteria: No shipped hook or script in plugins/herdr-ticks invokes a tk herd subcommand that no longer exists; either the plugin is removed or every hook resolves against a live command, and README no longer advertises removed behaviour as Working
